articles.summary: WEST PALM BEACH, Fla., Feb. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - LXP Industrial Trust (“LXP”) (NYSE: LXP), a real estate investment trust focused on Class A warehouse and distribution real estate investments, today announced results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025. Fourth Quarter 2025 Highlights Recorded Net Income attributable to common shareholders of $27.1 million, or $0.46 per diluted common share. Generated Adjusted Company Funds From Operations available to all equityholders - diluted (“Adjusted Company FFO”) of $47.0 million, or $0.79 per diluted common share. Same-Store NOI increased 2.9% for the full year and was in line for the quarter compared to the same periods in 2024. Completed 2.1 million square feet of new leases and lease extensions, increasing Base and Cash Base Rents by 27.4% and 22.6%, respectively, excluding two fixed-rate renewals. Sold four warehouse facilities outside of target markets for gross proceeds of $116.2 million. Repaid $140 million of 6.75% Senior
articles.title: LXP Industrial Trust Reports Fourth Quarter 2025 Results
